items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 2, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: That’s right. Bucky Pizzarelli and Ruth Pizzarelli... And of course Ruth going a week later you know.

ctx.x: There was a week, I believe near the end of March, where it seemed like every other day there was an obit.
That’s right. Bucky Pizzarelli and Ruth Pizzarelli, and Wallace Roney and many others.
And it just seemed like whoa, why is this hitting these older musicians with such regularity. And I remember thinking well Bucky was not in great health. We had almost lost him a couple of years ago.
